      "explanation": "The blanket wording could preclude future scientific objections without examining their merits.       "quote": "no one has a complete theory of consciousness and there are many challenges in the panpsychist worldview.",
      "explanation": "Goff acknowledges the combination problem, discusses split-brain research, and identifies the added complexity of a possible fallback. This qualifies his earlier simplicity claims at E1294–1298 and treats the objection as a research problem requiring an answer."
